ZinMemoryModel.AllocatorRule: Runtime heap allocation must be explicit through std.mem.Allocator, an explicitly allocator-owning object, or an explicitly named target primitive.
ZinMemoryModel.UndefinedBehavior: use-after-free; double-free unless allocator traps; invalid or misaligned pointer dereference; read of undefined storage; invalid type bit patterns; data race; foreign ABI violation
ZinMemoryModel.UndefinedValue: No initialization store is required; reading before initialization is undefined behavior. Safe builds may poison/trap.
